overall.summary: The many-service-calls part is described as raising the chance steadily from the first call, but it is off below 4 calls; its stated closed form has the wrong bias (-0.479 instead of -0.679). The rest reproduces.

findings.statement: This part raises the chance of leaving steadily with every call to customer service, from the first call on, except in West Virginia.
findings.check: probe --set state=OH --sweep 'number customer service calls=0:7:8'; C126 threshold 4 calls; lint flags C126 hinge with no hinge phrase
findings.evidence: ann_92 contribution is 0 (off) at 0, 1, 2 and 3 calls, then +0.585 at 4, +1.199 at 5, +1.813 at 6, +2.427 at 7 calls (Ohio customer). It adds nothing until 4 calls (C126), not from the first call.
commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify probe experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-fd4da7 --set state=OH --sweep "number customer service calls=0:7:8"

findings.check: verify recheck; node 7208 weights in the replayed model
findings.evidence: recomputed bias -0.679 (node 7208 bias -0.6786; weights CSC +0.5425, state:49 -0.3670). With -0.479 the hinge would open near 3 calls, not 4.
commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify recheck experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-fd4da7

findings.check: verify recheck (warn: 0.479 not in the computed closed form)

findings.statement: 7208 = relu(0.54 CSC - 0.37 state:49 - 0.48), readout +1.48; active only when CSC >= 4
findings.evidence: bias is -0.68, not -0.48 (the rest holds: readout +1.48, on from 4 calls, 306 of 318 customers with 4+ calls active, never in West Virginia, +0.61 logit per call 4->5). The payload's active_rows 304 differs slightly from the 306 recounted.
commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify subgroup experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-fd4da7 --where "`number customer service calls` >= 4"

findings.statement: acts on 306 of 4000, 154 left; 16% without, 26% with; off in West Virginia
findings.evidence: active 306 (96.2%) of the 318 with 4+ calls, 0 elsewhere; typical WV customer: ann_92 off at all call counts
commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify probe experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-fd4da7 --sweep "number customer service calls=0:7:8"

findings.check: least-squares linearisation of 7208 on CSC and state:49 (scratch linearise.py)

findings.statement: 1.0, full coverage, hierarchy complete, function preservation 7.2e-16, closed-form error 0.0077
findings.evidence: all recomputed equal; 158 of 158 claims reproduce; prose numbers all found

findings.statement: AUC 0.901; zeroing backbone 0.54; gate zeroed 0.7635; additive
findings.evidence: full 0.9009; backbone zeroed 0.539; gate zeroed 0.7635; state offsets zeroed 0.9009

findings.statement: fixed weights; day minutes, international plan, messages raise; voice-mail plan lowers
findings.evidence: backbone contribution rises linearly -3.148 at 91 min to +6.661 at 352 min (steady); claims reproduce
commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify probe experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-fd4da7 --sweep "total day minutes=91:352:10"

findings.statement: raises chance for low usage, more with service calls; day minutes lower it only below about 169
findings.check: probe 2-D sweep day minutes x calls (1, 4)
findings.evidence: 1 call: gate +6.57 at 50 min, +0.78 at 150, flat +0.138 from 175 min; 4 calls: +9.90 at 50, still +1.21 at 200, flat at 225: the kink moves up with calls
commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify probe experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-fd4da7 --sweep "total day minutes=50:250:9" --sweep "number customer service calls=1,4"

findings.statement: for CSC>=4 ... empirical churn 0.88 low-day vs 0.24 high-day, which the network reproduces
findings.evidence: CSC>=4 and day < 160 min: empirical 88.5% but mean predicted 65.4%; day < 130: 98.0% vs 77.5%; day >= 160: 28.8% vs 40.5%. The direction is reproduced, the size is not.
commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify subgroup experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-fd4da7 --where "`number customer service calls` >= 4 and `total day minutes` < 160"
